content: इरा [इ-रन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>; इं कामं राति रा-क वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] (‘इरा|तु मदिरावारिभारत्यशनभूमिषु’ इति विश्वलोचनः) .²1 The earth. .²2 Speech. .²3 The goddess of speech, Sarasvatī, .²4 Water. .²5 Food; इरावतीं धारिणीं भूधराणाम् <ls>Mb. 13. 26. 95</ls>. .²6 Spirituous liquor. .²7 Any drinkable fluid; a draught (especially of milk). .²8 Refreshment, comfort (<ab>Ved.</ab> in the last three senses). .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the wives of Kaśyapa.
